The paragraph [Division of Cook (1906–55)] explicitly states, "The Division of Cook was an Australian Electoral Division in New South Wales. It was created in 1906 and abolished in 1955. The Division was named for James Cook, who discovered the east coast of Australia in 1770. It was located in the inner suburbs of Sydney, taking in the suburbs of Alexandria, Redfern and Surry Hills."
